author: Nate Miller
title: Tim Tawa sent back to Triple-A
desc: Tim Tawa was optioned to Triple-A ahead of Thursday's game against the Cardinals.
impact: Tawa has appeared in four games since being called up this past week, but he has ultimately struggled overall in his opportunities for the Diamondbacks this season. Veteran outfielder Max Kepler has been activated in a corresponding move.

author: Nate Miller
title: Scott Barlow released by Athletics
desc: Scott Barlow was released by the Athletics on Wednesday.
impact: Barlow was designated for assignment this past Sunday. The veteran reliever subsequently cleared waivers and was cut loose by the Athletics. Barlow had struggled of late, giving up multiple runs in three of his last four relief appearances for the A's.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Isiah Kiner-Falefa (forearm) to be re-evaluated Friday
desc: Isiah Kiner-Falefa is scheduled to be re-evaluated on Friday.
impact: Kiner-Falefa was expected to be tested on Thursday, but he arrived late back in Boston. He was placed on the injured list last weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: CJ Abrams (side) not in lineup Thursday
desc: CJ Abrams is not in the Nationals lineup on Thursday against the Phillies.
impact: Abrams is still dealing with left side tightness. He is expected to be available off the bench.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jared Jones (elbow) scheduled to start Saturday
desc: The Pirates listed Jared Jones as their scheduled starter for Saturday's game against the Reds.
impact: Jones had to leave his last outing on Sunday against the Rockies after being struck by a comeback in the pitching elbow. He had imaging return clean and appears ready to go this weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Scherzer (back) to receive cortisone shot Friday
desc: Max Scherzer is traveling to Dallas on Friday to get a cortisone shot in his back.
impact: It is expected to help "alleviate some left side stuff" for Scherzer. He threw a bullpen on Thursday and is expected to return to Toronto over the weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yimi Garcia continuing to experience neck and biceps nerve symptoms
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Yimi Garcia is continuing to experience neck and biceps nerve symptoms.
impact: The team is still determining next steps for Garcia. He is without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Hollowell optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Cubs optioned Gavin Hollowell to Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Hollowell has been moved up and down multiple times this week. That'll likely continue for him throughout the summer.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matthew Boyd (knee) activated from IL
desc: The Cubs activated Matthew Boyd from the injured list.
impact: Boyd is set to officially make his return on Thursday for the Cubs. He will be pitching for the first time since May 3.

author: Ari Koslow
title: David Sandlin to start Friday
desc: David Sandlin will start on Friday for the White Sox against the Royals.
impact: Sandlin will return to the majors for his third start of June. He has allowed 11 runs across 7 1/3 innings over his last two starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ben Brown to miss extended time with stress reaction in neck
desc: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Ben Brown was diagnosed with a stress reaction in his neck.
impact: It is a similar injury to what Brown dealt with in 2024. He is expected to have limited activity over the next month, leaving him without a timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Brown to start Sunday
desc: Hunter Brown will start Sunday's series finale against the Tigers.
impact: Brown has allowed two runs over 8 2/3 innings across two starts since his return from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Madrigal elects free agency
desc: Nick Madrigal has elected free agency.
impact: Madrigal passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trevor Story (hernia) resumes hitting
desc: Trevor Story told reporters he has resumed hitting.
impact: Story was given a timeline to return of 8-12 weeks. He expects his return to be closer to the eight-week range.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Schwarber (back) returns to lineup Thursday
desc: Kyle Schwarber is back in the Phillies lineup on Thursday against the Nationals.
impact: Schwarber returns from a two-game absence. He is hitting second and serving as the designated hitter.
